follow-up time: Until delivery or end of study
outcome: Adverse events during infusion or within 72 hours
Admission to the intensive care unit
cohort: 13 hospitalized unvaccinated pregnant women with severe COVID-19 requiring oxygen
finding: Casirivimab/imdevimab therapy may be considered as a therapy in unvaccinated pregnant women with severe COVID-19.
mod_finding: Out of the 13 pregnancies, there were three cesarean deliveries and one vaginal delivery, with two being preterm deliveries (at 31 and 34 weeks) and two being term deliveries.
